scope.description: Unsupervised description and illustration of causal top-3 minute-path shapes.
scope.interpretation_limit: Shape structure only. No monetary or directional inference is made.

frozen_config.price_normalization: Return/range/close-position are algebraically invariant to dividing OHLC by each window's first close; cumulative gain remains session-open anchored.
frozen_config.algorithm: scikit-learn MiniBatchKMeans (k-means objective), n_init=10, batch_size=4096, max_iter=100
frozen_config.volume_normalization: current minute volume / trailing 20-grid-minute median, retained as-is

configuration_selection.rule: For each (L,k), fit on deterministic every-5th-minute windows (uniformly capped at 80,000). A configuration is balanced when its smallest cluster is at least 25% of equal occupancy (share >= 0.25/k). Among balanced configurations freeze the highest silhouette; ties prefer higher normalized occupancy entropy, then smaller L and k. If none balance, maximize normalized entropy, then silhouette.
configuration_selection.reason: No candidate met the occupancy-balance floor; the frozen fallback selected maximum normalized occupancy entropy (0.885933), then silhouette (0.005797).

corpus.membership: Each symbol-day is confirmed to appear in lb rank 1..3 at least once. Full-session windows are retained; endpoint rank is 1..3 when currently present and outside_top3_at_window_end otherwise.

month_stability.rule: stable iff mean monthly total-variation <= 0.10 and maximum <= 0.20

dtw_medoid_assignments.purpose: illustration only; not used for fitting or full-set assignment
dtw_medoid_assignments.method: multichannel standardized DTW, Sakoe-Chiba band=6, candidate-refined medoids
